project.visitorDecision: Choose a documented winter trail by activity, location and effort, then inspect weather and source-specific rules without mistaking modeled snow for winter access.
project.primaryAction: Select one of two compared trails and check regional NOAA/NWS weather before opening its official park or pathway guidance.

claims.subject: route-guidance
claims.limitation: NPS named snowshoe route documentation is not live confirmation of today’s trail, road or lot status.

claims.subject: route-guidance
claims.limitation: Official pathway route information identifies permitted uses but does not provide current grooming or plowed winter lots for all 15 featured systems.

claims.subject: weather-context
claims.limitation: NWS daytime forecast is for a regional map reference point and must never certify trail surface, route opening or visitor safety.

claims.subject: weather-context
claims.limitation: NOAA NOHRSC modeled 1-km snow analysis is not observed snow at the named trail, and it does not verify groomed tracks or a plowed parking approach.

claims.subject: park-access
claims.limitation: No fresh official notice certifies all featured trails, roads and lots open now. Visitors must check the operator before travel.

claims.subject: other
claims.limitation: Map markers are reference areas, not surveyed trail geometry or verified winter entrances.

decisionState.selectedIdField: route.id sourced from each existing .wf-story id
decisionState.sourceOfTruth: The existing 15 static source dossiers feed shortlist/pairFor; the matched route ID is passed into the existing NOAA/NWS weather inspector, never a second unsourced trail catalog.
decisionState.unavailableBehavior: If JavaScript, map tiles or NOAA/NWS evidence is unavailable, preserve the original named source-linked dossiers and show explicit unknown weather rather than a ready-to-go claim.

scenarios.input: 390px phone, default snowshoe, all regions and efforts
scenarios.expectedVisibleAnswer: Show the first named trail comparison option within the initial phone screen, followed by direct field notes and area-weather actions.
scenarios.sourceAndSafety: Matched options are editorial route comparisons and cannot certify current grooming, lot plowing or opening.

scenarios.input: Choose a different region or winter activity and inspect a new matched option
scenarios.expectedVisibleAnswer: The named compared trail and its weather action change together to the matching source dossier ID.
scenarios.sourceAndSafety: Only source-listed regions and modes are offered, and map markers remain regional areas.

scenarios.input: Choose Pictured Rocks, check NOAA/NWS weather, return to comparison, switch option and then restore original filters
scenarios.expectedVisibleAnswer: The shared weather inspector matches the selected trail and the return button restores focus to that same compared route, falling back to activity controls if no longer visible.
scenarios.sourceAndSafety: Original manager links remain available and no calculated safety verdict is introduced.

scenarios.expectedVisibleAnswer: Preserve the two static starting options, all 15 full trail dossiers, and links to official maps and snow sources.
scenarios.sourceAndSafety: The static HTML does not claim a live weather reading; its evidence note remains available.

scenarios.input: Block CARTO and OpenStreetMap tiles or disable Leaflet
scenarios.expectedVisibleAnswer: Keep a readable list of documented trails, source links and region filters independent of the map background.
scenarios.sourceAndSafety: Do not infer routable geometry or winter parking from reference points.

scenarios.input: Provide old or missing NOAA snow, NWS forecast or active-alert response
scenarios.expectedVisibleAnswer: Show Unknown for each stale element while retaining the selected place, source links and visitor cautions.
scenarios.sourceAndSafety: Stale weather is never a trail condition, opening or safety signal.

failures.no-js: Keep both crawlable static compared choices, all 15 trail descriptions and their official source links when browser scripts are off.
failures.no-tiles: Show map-unavailable message and source-linked trail list, with no fabricated path lines or lot directions.
failures.no-image: Retain the named route option, evidence text and official source when the credited image host is blocked.
failures.stale-data: Show Unknown with original NOAA and NWS source handoffs and the manager link; no green/open inference.

qa.scopeNote: A fresh public 390px screenshot showed no named trail option in the initial viewport; deterministic before/after Playwright, keyboard, no-script, map and source failure QA is required before approval. AdSense placement is unchanged.
